channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka oo cambaareeyay hadallada mas'uuliyiinta Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan Imaaraadka
item.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka (GCC), Jaasim Maxamed Al-Budaiwi, ayaa bayaan uu soo saaray 19 November ku cambaareeyay hadallada mas'uuliyiinta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo olole warbaahineed oo uu sheegay in lagu beegsanayo Imaaraadka Carabta.

item.title: WHO oo sheegtay in Ebola-da Congo ay weli tahay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg caalami ah
item.description: Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) ayaa go'aamiyay in cudurka Ebola ee ka dillaacay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo uu weli yahay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo caalami ah, iyadoo infekshannada iyo dhimashadu ay sii kordhayaan.

item.title: Ergeyada Mareykanka oo la sheegay inay soo jeediyeen in Ukraine NATO ku biirto haddii ay Donbas ka tanaasusho
item.description: Ergeyada Mareykanka Jared Kushner iyo Steve Witkoff ayaa la sheegay inay wada-hadallo xiran ku soo jeediyeen in Ukraine la siiyo xubinnimada NATO haddii ay Ruushka u dhaafto qaybta ka hartay gobolka Donbas.

item.title: NBA: Damian Lillard oo 33 dhibcood dhaliyay, Portland-na garaacday Bucks oo 12 kulan oo xiriir ah laga badiyay
item.description: Damian Lillard ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan dhibcihii ugu badnaa, 33 dhibcood, ku dhaliyay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Milwaukee tan iyo markii Bucks ay sii daysay, isagoo Portland Trail Blazers u horseeday guul.

item.title: MLS: Orlando City oo 3-1 looga adkaaday Cincinnati, xilli ciyaareedkii Griezmann oo dhammaaday
item.description: Kooxda Orlando City ee Antoine Griezmann ayaa Khamiistii 3-1 looga adkaaday FC Cincinnati kulan isreebreeb ah oo lagu kala saarayay kooxaha gelaya wareegga play-off-ka MLS, taasoo soo afjartay xilli ciyaareedka xiddigga reer Faransiiska.

item.title: Wembanyama oo sheegay in finan farta ka soo baxay uu ka joojiyay dunk-ka, qaab cusub oo tuuris ahna la yimid
item.description: Xiddigga San Antonio Spurs Victor Wembanyama ayaa kulankii ay Khamiistii ka adkaadeen Los Angeles Clippers ka tagay fursad dunk ah oo bannaan, isagoo kubbadda si tartiib ah dusha ka saaray giraanta, kadibna sheegay in sababtu ay tahay finan farta ka soo baxay.

item.title: Formula 1 oo ku dhow heshiis lagu soo celinayo matoorada V8 laga bilaabo 2030
item.description: Madaxda Formula 1 iyo shirkadaha matoorada samaysa ayaa la sheegay inay mabda' ahaan isku raaceen in matoorada V8 turbo hybrid ah ay bedelaan matoorada hadda la isticmaalo sannadka 2030.

item.title: Golaha Siyaasiyiinta Puntland oo ka soo horjeestay mamnuucidda shirarka mucaaradka ee Garoowe
item.description: Golaha Siyaasiyiinta iyo Aqoonyahanka Puntland ayaa cambaareeyay warqad ka soo baxday guddoomiyaha gobolka Nugaal oo lagu mamnuucay shirarka siyaasadeed ee mucaaradka magaalada Garoowe.

item.title: Napoli: Goolhaye Alex Meret oo la sheegay inuu laba bilood garoonka ka maqnaan doono
item.description: Goolhayaha Napoli Alex Meret, oo Khamiistii tababarka ka jabay lafta shanaad ee qaybta hoose ee laf-dhabarta, ayaa warbixinnada Talyaaniga sheegayaan inuu ku dhowaad laba bilood maqnaan doono.

item.title: Dagaalka Iran oo Mareykanka ku kacay 48.3 bilyan oo doollar, Senate-ka oo mar kale diiday ka saarista ciidamada
item.description: Musharrax ka tirsan Pentagon-ka ayaa Senate-ka Mareykanka u sheegay in howlgalka milatari ee ka dhanka ah Iran uu ilaa dabayaaqadii February ku kacay qiyaastii 48.3 bilyan oo doollar, iyadoo Senate-ku 48-51 ku diiday qaraar lagu dalbanayay ka saarista ciidamada.

item.title: Mareykanka oo iibiyay shatiyadii ugu horreeyay ee macdan qodista badda qoto dheer, maalmo kadib go'aan maxkamadeed
item.description: Maamulka Trump ayaa Khamiistii iibiyay shatiyadii ugu horreeyay taariikhda Mareykanka ee macdan qodista sagxadda badda qoto dheer, kuwaas oo ku yaal biyaha ka baxsan American Samoa, maalmo kadib markii maxkamad federaal ah ay sheegtay in habka loo oggolaaday uu sharci darro ahaa.

item.title: Formula 1: George Russell oo ugu dheereeyay tababarka labaad ee Las Vegas Grand Prix oo roob saameeyay
item.description: Darawalka Mercedes George Russell ayaa ugu waqti fiicnaa tababarka labaad ee Las Vegas Grand Prix, kaas oo lagu ciyaaray waddo qoyan oo si tartiib ah u qallalaysay roob kadib.

item.title: Kyiv: Laba buundo oo ku waxyeelloobay weerar gantaal oo Ruushku qaaday, sida uu sheegay duqa magaalada
item.description: Duqa magaalada Kyiv Vitali Klitschko ayaa sheegay in laba buundo oo caasimadda Ukraine ku yaal ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay weerarro Ruushku qaaday, kadib weerar gantaallo ballistic ah oo lagu beegsaday magaalada.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Golaha Samatabixinta Qaranka u sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay wada-hadal
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa farriin u diray Golaha Samatabixinta Qaranka oo uu ku muujiyay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu la fariisto mucaaradka, kulankana lagu qabto goob ay iyagu ku kalsoon yihiin.

item.title: Wasiirrada maaliyadda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada oo shir 48 saac ah ku soo gabagabeeyay Muqdisho
item.description: Shirka 25-aad ee Madasha Wasiirrada Maaliyadda ee dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Gobolka Banaadir ayaa Muqdisho lagu soo gabagabeeyay, iyadoo laga soo saaray warmurtiyeed ku saabsan dib-u-habeynta nidaamka maaliyadda.

item.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse: Soomaaliya kama sii tiirsana beesha caalamka, Imaaraadkana waa mas'uul
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa Jimcaha ka sheegay Muqdisho in dowladdu ay ka gudubtay ku tiirsanaanta beesha caalamka, isagoo dhanka kale Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeeyay inuu hurinayo dagaallada Koonfur Galbeed.

item.title: NBA: San Antonio Spurs oo 102-99 ku garaacay Clippers, Wembanyama oo kulankiisii 7-aad ee 30 dhibcood gaaray
item.description: San Antonio Spurs ayaa 102-99 kaga adkaaday Los Angeles Clippers, iyagoo dib ugu soo laabtay guusha laba maalmood kadib markii ay soo dhammaatay taxanihii 12 guulood ee isku xigay.

item.title: NFL: Houston Texans oo 26-3 ku garaacay Indianapolis Colts, CJ Stroud oo dhaliyay saddex touchdown
item.description: Houston Texans ayaa Khamiistii 26-3 kaga adkaaday Indianapolis Colts kulankii Thursday Night Football ee NFL, taasoo noqotay guushii ugu horreysay ee ay xilli ciyaareedkan ka gaaraan garoonkooda.

item.title: Kenya: Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka oo ka dhex baxay kulan ay la lahaayeen guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC
item.description: Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka Kenya ayaa Nairobi uga dhex baxay kulan wadatashi ah oo ay la lahaayeen guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inaan laga qeyb gelin diyaargarowga doorashada 2027.

item.title: NHL: Tampa Bay Lightning oo 3-1 ku garaacay Oilers, taxanihii dhibcaha ee Connor McDavid oo ku joogsaday 23 kulan
item.description: Taxanihii Connor McDavid ee dhibcaha ayaa ku joogsaday 23 kulan kadib markii Edmonton Oilers ay 3-1 uga dhaceen Tampa Bay Lightning kulan ka tirsan horyaalka NHL.

item.title: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya oo si weyn hoos ugu dhacay kadib diiwaangelinta Anthropic
item.description: Suuqyada saamiyada Japan, Kuuriyada Koonfureed, Taiwan iyo Hong Kong ayaa Jimcaha, 20 November, si weyn hoos ugu dhacay, iyadoo maalgashadayaashu ay ka walaacsan yihiin in maalgashiga sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) uu noqday mid aan sii socon karin.

item.title: Arda Güler iyo Kenan Yıldız oo ku jira musharaxiinta Globe Soccer Awards 2026
item.description: Ciyaartoyda reer Turkiga Arda Güler oo ka ciyaara Real Madrid iyo Kenan Yıldız oo ka ciyaara Juventus ayaa lagu daray 14-ka musharax ee abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka soo koraya ee Globe Soccer Awards 2026.

item.title: Australia oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Argentina furitaanka Koobka Adduunka U-17
item.description: Xulka da'da ka yar 17 sano ee Australia ayaa 19 November dalka Qatar 2-0 kaga adkaaday Argentina, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee Group C ee Koobka Adduunka U-17.

item.title: MLB: Chicago White Sox oo Luis Castillo iyo Davis Martin u wareejiyay Colorado Rockies
item.description: Kooxda baseball-ka ee Chicago White Sox ayaa ganacsi ay la gashay Colorado Rockies ku siisay tuurayaasha Luis Castillo iyo Davis Martin, iyagoo beddelkooda helay Sean Sullivan iyo ciyaaryahanka da'da yar Douglas Veliz.

item.title: Aqalka Cad oo beddelaya agaasimaha amniga internetka xilli dalka uu la daalaa dhacayo go'itaanno teknoolajiyadeed
item.description: Sean Cairncross, agaasimaha qaranka ee amniga internetka ee Aqalka Cad, ayaa xilkiisa ka tagaya, waxaana beddeli doonta Kirsten Davies, oo ah afhayeen ka tirsan Pentagon-ka, sida ay sheegeen warbaahinno badan oo Mareykan ah 19 November.

item.title: Buffalo Bills oo go'aansatay in lambarka 83 ee Andre Reed la hawlgabo xilliga 2027
item.description: Kooxda NFL ee Buffalo Bills ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqday in lambarka 83 ee Andre Reed, xiddigii hore ee kooxda, si rasmi ah loo hawlgabi doono inta lagu jiro xilliga 2027.

item.title: Afar meyd oo laga soo saaray badda kadib markii doon tahriib ay ku rogmatay xeebta Senegal
item.description: Afar meyd ayaa laga soo saaray badda kadib markii doon ay saarnaayeen muhaajiriin ay Arbacadii, 18 November, ku rogmatay xeebta Senegal meel u dhow magaalada Yenne oo ka koonfureysa Dakar.

item.title: Zverev oo garaacay Fils, kuna dhammaystay wareegga kooxaha ATP Finals isagoon set laga badin
item.description: Alexander Zverev ayaa 19 November magaalada Turin 6-4, 7-6 (8-6) kaga adkaaday Arthur Fils, wuxuuna kaalinta koowaad kaga gudbay kooxdiisa ATP Finals isagoon hal set laga badin.

item.title: Horyaalka haweenka Mareykanka NWSL oo ku dhawaaqay xeer cusub oo lagu horumarinayo ciyaartoyda da'da yar
item.description: Guddoomiyaha horyaalka kubadda cagta haweenka Mareykanka (NWSL), Jessica Berman, ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay xeer cusub oo kooxaha ku dhiirri-gelinaya inay maalgashadaan ciyaartoyda da'da yar.

item.title: Tom Sykes oo 10-9 kaga adkaaday Luke Humphries Grand Slam of Darts
item.description: Tom Sykes oo aan ka mid ahayn ciyaartoyda la kala horreysiiyay ayaa 19 November magaalada Wolverhampton 10-9 kaga adkaaday Luke Humphries, wareegga labaad ee Grand Slam of Darts.
